title: The completion of a finite module over a Noetherian ring is its base change to the completed ring
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/I^n$ the $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. For an $A$-module $P$ let $P^\wedge=\varprojlim_nP/I^nP$ (compatible sequences, an $A^\wedge$-module by $(a_n)_n\cdot(x_n)_n=(a_nx_n)_n$), with the $A$-linear map $\iota_P:P\to P^\wedge$, $x\mapsto(x\bmod I^nP)_n$, and for an $A$-linear $u:P\to Q$ let $u^\wedge:P^\wedge\to Q^\wedge$, $(x_n)_n\mapsto(u(x_n))_n$. Let $c_P:A^\wedge\otimes_AP\to P^\wedge$ be the $A^\wedge$-linear map with $c_P(a\otimes x)=a\cdot\iota_P(x)$ (the tensor product as in [def-weil-module-base-change], with $A^\wedge$ written on the left). Then (1) $c$ is natural: $u^\wedge\circ c_P=c_Q\circ(\mathrm{id}_{A^\wedge}\otimes u)$ for every $A$-linear $u:P\to Q$; (2) if $P$ is a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], then $c_P$ is bijective, so $P^\wedge\cong A^\wedge\otimes_AP$ as $A^\wedge$-modules.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00MA (lemma-completion-tensor, line 22901), part (3) (M^ = M (x)_R R^ for a finite module M over a Noetherian ring R); the naturality (1) is immediate from the formula of the map and is used in the proof of Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0882
